_source: 3.preprocessing_profiles/1.sc_quality_control.ipynb (as run for the HLHS dataset; executed copies in 3.preprocessing_profiles/qc_notebooks/)
notes: Only the oversegmented_nuclei thresholds differ between the two HLHS plates. Plate CARD-CelIns-CX7_260407120001 uses looser (2.0/2.0) thresholds than CARD-CelIns-CX7_260407190001 and every other plate seen so far, which use 1.0/1.0. The notebook has hardcoded this as a plate-name if/else since at least commit 9187d3a; the reason for the discrepancy (e.g. plate-specific imaging/segmentation quality) was not documented at the time, so it is preserved here as-is rather than reconciled. All other threshold sets (poorly_segmented_nuclei, undersegmented_cells, blurry_cells) are shared across both HLHS plates.
